name: phone-approve
description: Approve or deny Claude Code's permission prompts from Telegram, with the terminal prompt as the fallback.

botToken.title: Telegram bot token
botToken.description: Token of a dedicated bot from @BotFather (no webhook set on it).

chatId.title: Telegram chat id
chatId.description: The chat the requests go to: your own user id for a private chat with the bot.

timeoutSeconds.title: Phone timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the phone before leaving the decision to the terminal prompt.
